criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 3 closest to the showstopper. Frame 5 camouflage scalp behind the kicker and hook, pink sausage hand, brown mid tone field. Frame 8 blank brown rectangle, no window, mannequins. Frame 4 blown white bottom third, laptop floats, sheet unreadable. Pavers read as floating planks, inlays flat red, sprite tufts. Desk under a third on 6 and 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero, the walk as a spine, one computed west key, both declared devices work. Frame 5's brown field and frame 8's interior sit outside the lawn world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and was recomputed. Looseness: frame 4 and caption 'faculty and staff document' go past c19's bare title quote at medium confidence, and the web edition goes further; 'two committees' reads a plural; c18's absence at medium; frame 9's invitation over the town hall paver; first comment omits c16.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, the institution and the campuses are clear; the missing adopting body is stated; frame 9 gives no seminar time and no form address.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Real turn at 4 and 7; modest cover; 5 re-covers 2; 8 doubles back after 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; four mechanical 'drawn to illustrate' disclaimers; procedural deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New hero and topic; third dark staged night deck in a row; lastLight at el 6.4 repeats no. 46; one paver per day repeats no. 46's lamp per day; lit screen repeats no. 47; block count echoes nos. 44 and 47; room from the back echoes nos. 43 and 45.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 5, 8 and 9 without the kit mannequins: crop 5 to lit forearms and hands at the keys below the type, light 8 from a modelled window where the brown rectangle hangs, and close 9 low and near so the desk fills a third of the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Camouflage scalp behind the kicker and hook, sausage hand, brown mid tone field.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera to desk height, crop to forearm and hands at the keys, no head in the top half, lid the one source, near black field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat brown rectangle reads as a placeholder; no window; mannequins; near chair a black slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A modelled window with mullions, sill and the warm seam beyond, the room's one source, the lectern in its pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blown white bottom third, floating laptop, unreadable sheet.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Key off the desk top, contact shadow under the laptop, the lid's shadow across the sheet's edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Desk under a fifth of the frame; mannequin walker with white hair beside the desk.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera low and close behind the walker, desk a third of the frame, walker cropped to legs and shoes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pavers as floating plywood, inlays flat red, desk small.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sink pavers flush with dark soil joints, low roughness inlays with one specular streak, desk a third of the frame tall.
